0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000010_WATCHEROFMOON
0.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I thank you for affording me this short reprieve...<hex:0248020103>

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000020_YSHTOLA
1.description: It is we who should thank you. The records stored here are nothing short of extraordinary.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000030_YSHTOLA
2.description: There is much we could learn of Zodiark and His imprisonment, but perhaps you could offer us more focused guidance. Pray tell us of the calamity that came before and comes now again.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000040_WATCHEROFMOON
3.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Long ago, before the great sundering, there was but a single world─Etheirys.<hex:0248020103>

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000050_WATCHEROFMOON
4.description: <hex:024804F2022303>One day, from within the earth, a terrible cry issued forth, affecting a profound change in all manner of life.<hex:0248020103>

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000060_WATCHEROFMOON
5.description: <hex:024804F2022303>We were not exempt. Our creation magicks ran rampant, giving shape and form to thoughts of hopelessness and despair.<hex:0248020103>

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000070_WATCHEROFMOON
6.description: <hex:024804F2022303>At first, the phenomenon was limited to a single region. But quickly...so very quickly...it spread and engulfed the whole of the star.<hex:0248020103>

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000080_YSHTOLA
7.description: Were the ancients ever able to deduce its source?

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000090_WATCHEROFMOON
8.description: <hex:024804F2022303>They were not. However, the Convocation struck upon a method to predict where next the corruption would manifest.<hex:0248020103>

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000100_WATCHEROFMOON
9.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The aetheric energies which flow through all of creation in the form of various currents.<hex:0248020103>

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000110_WATCHEROFMOON
10.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The currents which course through the land and seas...<hex:0248020103>

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000120_WATCHEROFMOON
11.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Those which flow through the very air...<hex:0248020103>

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000130_WATCHEROFMOON
12.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And those of a celestial nature which encompass both our star and this moon.<hex:0248020103>

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000140_YSHTOLA
13.description: Celestial currents... I cannot say I am familiar with the concept.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000150_WATCHEROFMOON
14.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Nor would I expect you to be. Few scholars of our time knew of their existence.<hex:0248020103>

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000160_WATCHEROFMOON
15.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Their invaluable knowledge helped us to better understand the nature of the calamity.<hex:0248020103>

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000170_WATCHEROFMOON
16.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Like the terrestrial ones of earth and air, the celestial currents form a vast network. But the aetherial distribution is not consistent.<hex:0248020103>

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000180_WATCHEROFMOON
17.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The Convocation soon realized that the inciting incidents occurred in regions where the flow was weakest.<hex:0248020103>

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000190_WATCHEROFMOON
18.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Correlation without clear cause, ultimately. Nevertheless, on closer study, a stagnancy of aether was observed in nearby currents...<hex:0248020103>

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000200_URIANGER
19.description: And so they sought a means to harness the forces of Darkness, of activity and growth. Thus was Zodiark conceived.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000210_URIANGER
20.description: No less a power than a god's could set right the laws of nature and quicken the flow of aether within the star.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000220_WATCHEROFMOON
21.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Precisely. With the advent of Zodiark, our end was averted.<hex:0248020103>

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000230_THANCRED
22.description: Emet-Selch claimed that those who summoned Hydaelyn did so because they saw Zodiark's power as a threat. Is that true?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000240_WATCHEROFMOON
23.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Indeed, there was a faction opposed to Zodiark's creation. But their aim was never to unmake Him.<hex:0248020103>

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000250_WATCHEROFMOON
24.description: <hex:024804F2022303>They understood the continued preservation of the natural order was dependent on His very existence. Until we could identify and address the underlying cause of the Final Days, He would need remain, for His departure would set in motion those apocalyptic forces once more.<hex:0248020103>

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000260_WATCHEROFMOON
25.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hydaelyn recognized this as well. And so, rather than destroy, She sundered Zodiark, Herself, and the star into lesser reflections, that She might confine Him in this place.<hex:0248020103>

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
27.description: I could have sworn She beseeched me to banish the Darkness.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
28.description: Then what She told me in the aetherial sea was false...?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000270_WATCHEROFMOON
29.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Perhaps She did. But as with all beings, intent is not always in accord with spoken word.<hex:0248020103>

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000280_WATCHEROFMOON
30.description: <hex:024804F2022303>That the two once dwelled as one until Zodiark grew hungry for power, upsetting the balance 'twixt Them...? Not quite a lie, though a rather gross embellishment.<hex:0248020103>

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000290_WATCHEROFMOON
31.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But knowing what you know now, you must surely realize why She might opt to obfuscate and mislead.<hex:0248020103>

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000300_WATCHEROFMOON
32.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hydaelyn and Zodiark are both constructs of man. Approximations of perfection limited by our own imperfections.<hex:0248020103>

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000310_WATCHEROFMOON
33.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Zodiark was, without question, the more powerful of the two, having been born from the sacrifice of half Etheirys's population.<hex:0248020103>

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000320_WATCHEROFMOON
34.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Thus was it necessary for Hydaelyn to commit Herself wholly to His defeat. Still more effort was needed to confine Him.<hex:0248020103>

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000330_WATCHEROFMOON
35.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Maintaining the brands taxed Her greatly. With what power She dared spare, She cried out to any who might listen, and offered Her blessing to those who heeded Her call.<hex:0248020103>

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000340_WATCHEROFMOON
36.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Though it was likely within Her power to do so, I believe She did not wish to speak of Etheirys and Her history.<hex:0248020103>

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000350_WATCHEROFMOON
37.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Like Zodiark, Hydaelyn's purpose is a reflection of Her creators'. They wished to look to the future, and not linger in a prison of the past.<hex:0248020103>

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000360_YSHTOLA
38.description: The Ascians set in motion seven Rejoinings before we came to oppose them. How many more worlds would have been lost had we not placed our faith in Her?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000370_YSHTOLA
39.description: How many more souls living in the present would have been snuffed out for the sake of those long dead?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000380_THANCRED
40.description: Well, in light of recent events, I see no reason to doubt your words.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000390_THANCRED
41.description: And even if Hydaelyn is not a god in truth, if Minfilia believed that we should trust in Her plans, then I choose to do just that.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000400_THANCRED
42.description: Which brings me to a rather important question.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000410_THANCRED
43.description: Let's suppose we try but fail to stop this second coming of the Final Days.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000420_THANCRED
44.description: Should the Source fall, what will become of the other worlds?

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000430_WATCHEROFMOON
45.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The nomenclature is more fitting than you know...<hex:0248020103>

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000440_WATCHEROFMOON
46.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Bring ruin to the Source, and its reflections will share in its fate.<hex:0248020103>

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000460_WATCHEROFMOON
48.description: <hex:024804F2022303>This way, if you would be so kind.<hex:0248020103>

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000490_WATCHEROFMOON
51.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hydaelyn knew better than any that Her power was not absolute. Indeed, She has ever struggled to hold Zodiark and His faithful at bay.<hex:0248020103>

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000500_WATCHEROFMOON
52.description: <hex:024804F2022303>She feared the worst, and so made preparations. In the event of His demise, there would be a contingency.<hex:0248020103>

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000510_WATCHEROFMOON
53.description: <hex:024804F2022303>This moon is more than a prison. It is a vessel capable of bearing the people of Etheirys to safe harbor.<hex:0248020103>

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000520_WATCHEROFMOON
54.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You need not go far to find its pilots. In fact, I should be happy to take you to them...<hex:0248020103>

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000530_WATCHEROFMOON
55.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...And fulfill my final duty as watcher in the dark.<hex:0248020103>

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000540_THANCRED
56.description: Our “moonship” pilots should be around here somewhere, is that right?

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000560_LIVINGWAY
58.description: (-???-)I know, I know─this one thousand two hundred and forty-third inspection is a mite ahead of schedule, but it is of the utmost importance! For Zodiark, alas, is no more.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000570_LIVINGWAY
59.description: (-???-)As of now, our mighty moon has a new purpose! To bear the people of Etheirys to safety!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000590_LIVINGWAY
61.description: (-???-)We must be swifter than swift! There is much to do before our guests arrive.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000600_LIVINGWAY
62.description: (-???-)I expect your work stations to be immaculate. And don't forget to relay our signal to Etheirys!

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000610_LIVINGWAY
63.description: (-???-)Questions? Yes? No? Maybe so? No? Then hop to it!

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000620_URIANGER
64.description: 'Tis a rather curious crew She hath chosen. Their endearing forms intended to ease the passengers' hearts, perhaps.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000640_LIVINGWAY
66.description: (-Snappy Loporrit-)Right, of course! Introductions are in order. Ahem!

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000650_LIVINGWAY
67.description: My name is Livingway, and we are the Loporrits. Created for the express purpose of commanding this ship and bearing the people of Etheirys to a brave new world!

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000660_LIVINGWAY
68.description: More specifically, <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> am the one whom She charged with the execution of Her most vital plans. You might say I'm Her right paw!

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000670_MAPPINGWAY
69.description: Mappingway's the name. Map reader and navigator of the heavens.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000680_THANCRED
70.description: Pleasure to meet you all, but...I'm still trying to make sense of...this.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000690_LIVINGWAY
71.description: Confusion and bewilderment are completely understandable. Fear not! I shall walk you through it.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000700_LIVINGWAY
72.description: The people of Etheirys─through no fault of your own, I'm sure─set in motion a series of events that, unfortunately, culminated in Zodiark's obliteration.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000710_LIVINGWAY
73.description: Acutely aware of the imminent crisis, your parents sent you little ones on ahead while they began the necessary preparations.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000720_LIVINGWAY
74.description: Still not following? No? Very well! I shall elaborate further!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000730_LIVINGWAY
75.description: Here we have Etheirys─your home─and the moon, where we are now.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000740_LIVINGWAY
76.description: Without Zodiark around to keep things lively, so to speak, the celestial currents of the star have doubtless begun to degrade.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000750_LIVINGWAY
77.description: A calamity of apocalyptic proportions will be visited upon Etheirys, bringing an end to all life. Very sad, that.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000760_URIANGER
78.description: So too hath the watcher claimed. By thine unperturbed countenance, I gather this eventuality was anticipated?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000770_LIVINGWAY
79.description: The doom and gloom? Oh yes, quite expected.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000780_LIVINGWAY
80.description: Imagine, if you will, that Etheirys is a delicious carrot that I've forgotten to eat and left out in the midday sun.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000790_LIVINGWAY
81.description: The most earnest wishes or prayers will not stop it from rotting to the core.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000800_LIVINGWAY
82.description: So, sadly, there's nothing to be done but to abandon said carrot─Etheirys, in case the metaphor is lost on you─to its grisly fate.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000810_YSHTOLA
83.description: ...And this moon will serve as the vessel to deliver us to a new home.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000820_LIVINGWAY
84.description: Just so! We will gather up as many people, supplies, and resources as our stores will hold.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000830_LIVINGWAY
85.description: And then, once everyone is aboard, it's off to another star!

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000840_LIVINGWAY
86.description: Easier said than done, admittedly, for one does not simply hop from star to star on a whim. Which is precisely why we've spent countless years constructing the most propulsive of propulsion systems!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000850_LIVINGWAY
87.description: We ought to make it to our destination in two shakes of a rabbit's tail.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000860_YSHTOLA
88.description: Impressive technology. I daresay it is beyond anything we have ever seen.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000870_LIVINGWAY
89.description: No need to shower us with praise. All we've done is faithfully carry out the instructions left to us by Hydaelyn.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000880_LIVINGWAY
90.description: Back in the old days, when She was still just Venat, She was dedicated to the study of the world and its inner workings.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000890_LIVINGWAY
91.description: And the watcher─the real one, not the simulacrum you met─was one of Her fellow researchers.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000900_LIVINGWAY
92.description: We and this wondrous vessel masquerading as a moon are products of their knowledge and know-how.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000910_THANCRED
93.description: There's certainly more to you all than meets the eye. Might I ask where exactly you intend to take us?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000920_MAPPINGWAY
94.description: We identified a few promising candidates for resettlement some time ago, but we cannot guarantee that they are fit for habitation.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000930_MAPPINGWAY
95.description: Moreover, the ship can only travel in short bursts. We intend to go down our list, hopping from star to star, until we find one suitable for resettlement.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000940_LIVINGWAY
96.description: No need to worry, though. The vessel is being refurbished with accommodation for an extended stay as we speak.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000950_LIVINGWAY
97.description: While we did have to rely upon outside help to determine what amenities were essential, I daresay we have risen to the challenge.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000970_LIVINGWAY
99.description: From you and yours, who else? Each time we woke to perform regularly scheduled maintenance, we were greeted by the resources you sent us. What better way to learn about the preferences and proclivities of our present-day charges?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000980_LIVINGWAY
100.description: Ah, but you're still adorable little children. Perhaps your elders were responsible for the deliveries?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_000990_THANCRED
101.description: I'm not sure what led you to conclude otherwise, but I can assure you that we are all grown men and women.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001000_THANCRED
102.description: And I very much doubt my “elders” know this place exists, much less how to send you so much as a Starlight missive.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001010_LIVINGWAY
103.description: What? Then who in blazes let you on <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> moon!?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001030_LIVINGWAY
105.description: You don't say! Well, that's... Really? Not children? Then why are you so small and stunted? Like little baby carrot people?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001040_YSHTOLA
106.description: While Amaurotines were a great deal taller, in the present day, persons of such prodigious size are exceedingly rare.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001050_LIVINGWAY
107.description: So...you're saying everyone's not like the watcher?

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001060_LIVINGWAY
108.description: Confound it all! Someone could've at least scribbled a note about your profound miniaturization...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001080_LIVINGWAY
110.description: Oh, this? One of the first books sent to us. A compendium of the people of Etheirys─with a few blank pages at the back for minor corrections and updates as needed.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001090_LIVINGWAY
111.description: The sum total of our knowledge of your kind is contained in these pages.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001100_LIVINGWAY
112.description: I thought it was abridged and made small for our benefit, but...this isn't a regular-sized book, is it?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001120_LIVINGWAY
114.description: Buildingway, can you hear me? Yes, we're all very busy.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001130_LIVINGWAY
115.description: Change of plans. I need you to rebuild the domiciles at one-third the scale.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001140_LIVINGWAY
116.description: All of them. Yes, <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> of them! And but me no buts! See to it with all speed!

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001150_THANCRED
117.description: Perhaps you could tell us a bit more about your terrestrial collaborators.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001160_LIVINGWAY
118.description: Yes, yes, in due time─but first I'd like to hear more about <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, if it's all the same. I'd rather not risk any other complications due to outdated knowledge of our passengers-to-be.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001180_GROWINGWAY
120.description: Huh? Access to living quarters restricted due to reconstruction? Then where is it... Oh no!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001190_URIANGER
121.description: A private audience, as thou didst request. For reasons I know not...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001200_LIVINGWAY
122.description: Just a precaution. I'd rather I didn't have to ask the question at all, but I take my responsibilities very, very seriously.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001210_LIVINGWAY
123.description: Do you and your friends, by any chance, find our accommodation wanting? Be honest. Brutally, even.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001220_URIANGER
124.description: 'Twould be ungracious of me to belittle the efforts of thee and thine.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001230_LIVINGWAY
125.description: Lovely sentiment, really, but the disappointment is writ plain on your comrades' faces. It's all the more frustrating since no one will come out and say what they find wanting!

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001240_LIVINGWAY
126.description: If there are faults in our work, we need to know. We can─we will─do better. But time is not on our side.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001250_LIVINGWAY
127.description: The Final Days will wait for no one. If your people are to be saved, we must take quick and decisive action.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001260_LIVINGWAY
128.description: This vessel must serve as a home for as many passengers as possible─for far longer than we may like. Which brings me to my request.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001270_LIVINGWAY
129.description: Our collaborators on Etheirys are doing what they can to prepare for the voyage. Would you be willing to go and lend them a hand?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001280_LIVINGWAY
130.description: Having seen the moon for yourself, you could speak to its many splendors. Learn what else they might require and assuage whatever concerns they have.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001290_URIANGER
131.description: Wherefore wouldst thou entrust me with such a task?

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001300_LIVINGWAY
132.description: How to put it... You're the only one who appears not to be wholly unsatisfied with our work.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001310_LIVINGWAY
133.description: Or quite good at pretending that's the case, at least. Calm, collected, tactful to a fault─very particular with your words, too.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001320_LIVINGWAY
134.description: You understand that, in the face of great danger, one cannot pursue perfection at the expense of practicality. That difficult choices must often be made for the greater good.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001330_URIANGER
135.description: And so fate doth conspire to set my feet upon this path once more...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001350_URIANGER
137.description: Ah, idle musings. 'Tis no trifle thou dost ask, yet full well do I understand the urgency...and necessity...

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001370_GROWINGWAY
139.description: Oh, dear me, dear me! I'm terribly sorry for the mix-up!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001380_GROWINGWAY
140.description: It's a bit of a malfunction. I hadn't realized the residential quarters were inaccessible, you see...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001390_GROWINGWAY
141.description: But you're still in one piece, so all's well that ends well, yes? Won't happen again. I promise!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001400_URIANGER
142.description: Thine arrival is timely as ever.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001410_URIANGER
143.description: Thou didst chance to overhear my conversation with Livingway, I presume?

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001420_URIANGER
144.description: 'Twas not mine intent to move in shadow. Nevertheless, I have been asked to do that and more yet again...

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001430_URIANGER
145.description: Is it so plain that these strangers could intuit it at a glance? My capacity for silence and secrecy...and duplicity.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001440_URIANGER
146.description: When G'raha Tia did contrive to deliver the First at the price of his own life, I was complicit in the scheme. A sacrifice averted, for a mercy.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001450_URIANGER
147.description: Would that I could say the same for Minfilia. One life for one world. And by that bloody bargain brokered by my hand were the Scions robbed of a dear comrade, and F'lhaminn her beloved daughter.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001460_URIANGER
148.description: Two souls whose selflessness was beyond measure, whose resolve was unshakable. They would not be moved even had I thought to protest.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001470_URIANGER
149.description: But protest I did not. Far from it. I pushed them forward.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001480_URIANGER
150.description: No effort did I make to seek out alternatives. Ones that would not demand such terrible costs.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001490_URIANGER
151.description: That resignation weigheth heavy on my mind, as does the memory of another lost to mine inaction.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001500_URIANGER
152.description: Dearest Moenbryda, who did face death unflinching, that we might secure a means to bring low the Ascians.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001510_URIANGER
153.description: In her hour of need, I did naught. Dutiful disciple of Louisoix, ever looking to the greater good...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001520_URIANGER
154.description: Had I shut mine eyes and bid her live instead, mayhap she would be with us today.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001530_URIANGER
155.description: Selfish wants born of everlasting regrets. Most days I put them from my mind, but could think of naught else when asked to swallow the same bitter draught. Subterfuge and sacrifice. Mayhap the right, moral choice, but one I regard with great trepidation.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001540_URIANGER
156.description: The calamity of Amaurot was a tragedy beyond reckoning. One which must never again come to pass.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001550_URIANGER
157.description: Thus must we struggle. Haunted by ghosts of those we have lost. Clinging to those we pray we can yet save.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001560_URIANGER
158.description: But what of those we cannot?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001570_URIANGER
159.description: How do we make peace with the dreadful algebra of necessity?

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
162.description: Have faith in yourself and your decisions. Take heart and protect well those you can.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
163.description: Would that we had time to weigh the costs...

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001580_URIANGER
164.description: I am not alone in my discomfort, then?

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001590_URIANGER
165.description: 'Tis surprising...though perhaps not. We Scions are wont to debate strategy at length, but are resolute and unwavering in execution.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001610_URIANGER
167.description: I see. Wisdom as befits a great wyrm. Curious that he should think thee in need of such encouragement.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001620_URIANGER
168.description: 'Tis a comfort to know we are of like mind in that regard.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001630_URIANGER
169.description: Strange... Scarcely can I remember when last we spoke alone, and so candidly.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001640_URIANGER
170.description: I thank thee. For all my supposed skill with words, I find it difficult to express such private thoughts.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001650_URIANGER
171.description: As for the Loporrits' proposition...I will take time and consider how to respond.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001660_URIANGER
172.description: 'Twould be to our mutual benefit if we could converse more openly with our aspiring caretakers...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001670_URIANGER
173.description: ...A concern I should be glad to address on the Scions' behalf.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001680_URIANGER
174.description: To dispense with all pretense and bare one's heart to another is a frightening thing indeed. But we cannot move forward ere we take that bold first step. A lesson I have learned many times before...and today.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001690_LIVINGWAY
175.description: What are they saying? Curse these ears─I've heard bugger all!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001700_LIVINGWAY
176.description: No matter. We've got our plans.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001710_URIANGER
177.description: ...And what, pray tell, do we seek at the Watcher's Palace?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001720_LIVINGWAY
178.description: Oh, come off it, friend! You know full well why we're here.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001730_LIVINGWAY
179.description: The time has come for you to return to Etheirys and help your brethren prepare for their journey here and beyond!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001740_URIANGER
180.description: Forgive me, Livingway, but I cannot in good conscience proceed with this plan.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001750_MAPPINGWAY
181.description: Huh!? But what about the Final Days? The death and the doom!? We have to hurry before it's too late!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001760_URIANGER
182.description: Your unflagging commitment to your duty is endearing, to say the least.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001780_URIANGER
184.description: Be at ease. They bear you no grudge, nor do I. How could we, having come to understand your purpose?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001790_URIANGER
185.description: For millennia, you and yours worked tirelessly towards the singular purpose of this heavenly vessel's construction. An arduous feat by any measure.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001800_URIANGER
186.description: 'Tis clear you have spared no effort. Why, your very names are a testament to your dedication.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001810_LIVINGWAY
187.description: Our...our names? I'm not sure I understand what you're getting at...

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001820_URIANGER
188.description: Names are an expression of the self─a declaration of one's hopes and aspirations.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001830_URIANGER
189.description: Your use of contemporary, uncomplicated nomenclature doth ensure clarity of purpose.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001840_URIANGER
190.description: There can be no doubt that your love for the people of Etheirys is boundless and pure.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001850_SINGINGWAY
191.description: Yes, yes! A most mellifluous phrasing!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001860_SINGINGWAY
192.description: We Loporrits were born of Hydaelyn's love for Etheirys.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001870_SINGINGWAY
193.description: That shining, shimmering blue jewel. Brightest star in the sky! Brimming with life and possibilities.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001880_MAPPINGWAY
194.description: For as long as I can remember I've toiled in anticipation of the day when this vessel might be needed.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001890_MAPPINGWAY
195.description: All I've ever wanted was to meet those She cherished so dearly. To serve and serve well!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001900_LIVINGWAY
196.description: That goes for all of us, don't you see? So help us─help us help them! Lead them here, where we can keep them safe!

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001910_LIVINGWAY
197.description: If there's anything wrong with what we've built, we'll fix it! We'll make it right!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001920_URIANGER
198.description: Your works want not for repair. Yet there remaineth much for you to learn of men, and your own kin besides.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001930_URIANGER
199.description: Singingway. Thy name bespeaketh more than the simple marriage of rhythm and rhyme.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001940_URIANGER
200.description: The songs of Etheirys are beyond counting, and span the length and breadth of emotion.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001950_URIANGER
201.description: Maps are monuments to man's pioneering spirit and his devotion to charting the furthest reaches of our star.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001960_URIANGER
202.description: Many have devoted their lifetimes to exploratory pursuits. To venture unto the highest mountains and the deepest oceans, in search of unknown frontiers.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001970_URIANGER
203.description: And thou, my friend. I... Hmm. I do not think we have met.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_001990_URIANGER
205.description: Puddingway... Yes, indeed. A name of deep and abiding significance, I am sure, but one perhaps better communicated through delicious deeds than tasteless words.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002000_URIANGER
206.description: A judicious application of fae magicks at a later juncture may be appropriate...

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002010_URIANGER
207.description: And Livingway. 'Tis no easy feat to convey the significance of thy moniker.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002020_URIANGER
208.description: Hmmm... When I was a bookish boy, a dear friend of mine was fond of peppering me with questions as I read─to my occasional annoyance. One day I posed to her a question of mine own─what doth it mean to live?

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002030_URIANGER
209.description: After much contemplation, she proffered this answer.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002040_URIANGER
210.description: The anticipation of a half-read story's conclusion. The hope today's mistake may serve as tomorrow's lesson.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002050_URIANGER
211.description: The wish that a new acquaintance may one day call thee friend. She believed it to be all these moments and more.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002070_URIANGER
213.description: I, too, still labor to find mine own answer. 'Twould be my pleasure to assist you and yours in embarking on a journey of self-discovery and enlightenment.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002090_URIANGER
215.description: Ink as blue as the waters of Etheirys. Made in haste, though I assure thee the quality has not suffered for it.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002100_URIANGER
216.description: The people need not be persuaded by honeyed words. Nay, I have faith they shall do what is right in due course.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002110_URIANGER
217.description: Until they do, I beg your patience, friends. And with that ink let us fill the empty pages of Livingway's compendium.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002120_URIANGER
218.description: An open exchange of ideas will surely afford you all a better understanding of modern man─and with it, ideas for improvements and renovations.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002130_URIANGER
219.description: But more importantly, it shall empower us to together find a way forward.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002140_LIVINGWAY
220.description: I hope you're right. Thank you for this lovely gift.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002150_URIANGER
221.description: There you have it. I shall remain with the Loporrits to ensure that all is in order.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002160_URIANGER
222.description: Though we must needs prepare for every eventuality, you would all agree that the evacuation of our star is a last resort.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002170_URIANGER
223.description: To accept failure is to accept the demise not only of our star, but that of Ryne's. Of all reflections, and the souls that call them home.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002180_URIANGER
224.description: Which is why I have every faith that you shall fight to the last. That such drastic measures may prove unnecessary.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002190_THANCRED
225.description: Should the worst come to the worst─and I pray deeply that it won't─I'll take comfort in knowing preparations were made under your watchful eye.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002200_URIANGER
226.description: Aye, thou mayest be assured that if calamity cometh, not a soul will be left behind. “If” being the operative term.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002210_WATCHEROFMOON
227.description: <hex:024804F2022303>That flower... How came it into your possession?<hex:0248020103>

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002230_WATCHEROFMOON
229.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Guided by its light, you may come to know Her true intentions. Intentions which remain a mystery even to us.<hex:0248020103>

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002240_WATCHEROFMOON
230.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In our time, we called it “Elpis”... You would do well to remember the name.<hex:0248020103>

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002250_LIVINGWAY
231.description: Er, I hate to interrupt, but...I feel like I need to make amends for all the secrecy.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002260_YSHTOLA
232.description: Think nothing of it─we haven't been the most gracious of guests. Do convey our apologies to Growingway and the others.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002270_LIVINGWAY
233.description: But of course! And when next we welcome more guests from Etheirys, we'll have learned to be much more hospitable hosts!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002280_LIVINGWAY
234.description: Oh, and circling back to the matter of inappropriate secrecy, we ought to discuss our benefactors.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002310_YSHTOLA
237.description: The more I heard, the more obvious it became. The Forum's aims align closely with those of your anonymous patrons. “A telling coincidence” would be an understatement.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002320_YSHTOLA
238.description: Though had we not taken it upon ourselves to peruse certain restricted tomes in Labyrinthos, we might still be unaware of their plans.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002330_YSHTOLA
239.description: ...But let us continue this discussion upon our return. I daresay we have kept Alphinaud and the others waiting long enough.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002350_BARNIER
241.description: I thank you all for gathering here on such short notice.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002360_BARNIER
242.description: This day we must speak of grave affairs and their implications for the future of Sharlayan─nay, of this very star.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002370_BARNIER
243.description: Said affairs concern all citizens, and so we have called for a public assembly.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002380_BARNIER
244.description: You may have heard rumors of the Telophoroi, and the havoc these madmen wreak abroad.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002390_BARNIER
245.description: Under normal circumstances, we would pay little heed to petty disturbances outside our borders. The “Final Days,” however, are another matter altogether...

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002400_BARNIER
246.description: ...For we dare not ignore these prophetic words of eld:

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002410_BARNIER
247.description: “The end-bearers will come, ushering chaos and calamity. The Final Days descend and devour the very star...”

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002430_SHARLAYANCITIZENB
249.description: Is it true? Will all that really happen?

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002440_BARNIER
250.description: Calm yourselves. The time is come to speak of the Forum's most sacred duties. But first...

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002450_LEGISLATORA
251.description: Give voice to the voiceless. Let bindings be unbound. By unanimous decree, I declare the enchantment broken!

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002480_FOURCHENAULT
254.description: Two hundred and seventy years ago, our forebears began an expedition in the Dravanian hinterlands, in search of a route to access the aetherial sea.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002490_FOURCHENAULT
255.description: This much is public knowledge. Their findings, however, would become the Forum's most closely guarded secret.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002500_FOURCHENAULT
256.description: What those researchers discovered in the hinterlands was not a passage unto the aetherial sea, but the very heart of our star─and Hydaelyn Herself.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002510_FOURCHENAULT
257.description: She spoke to them of a calamity that would extinguish all life, and of a means by which we might be spared.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002520_FOURCHENAULT
258.description: The moon. 'Tis in truth a gargantuan vessel built to serve as sanctuary for Her children and deliver them from this doom.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002530_FOURCHENAULT
259.description: Much like <hex:021A020203>Nyunkrepf's Hope<hex:021A020103> in ages past, it will bear the people of a world in the throes of death to a new home.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002540_BARNIER
260.description: Needless to say, this would be no small undertaking. To facilitate the great work, the Forum has maintained close contact with the servants of Hydaelyn who presently reside on the moon.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002550_BARNIER
261.description: Convinced that the foretold end was all but inevitable, we began amassing a wealth of knowledge. Not merely for the betterment of our nation, but in preparation for the journey to come.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002560_SHARLAYANCITIZENA
262.description: You reveal this to us now? By the gods, how long do we have!?

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002570_BARNIER
263.description: While we cannot say with certainty, we believe the hour to be nigh. We received a transmission from the moon suggesting as much not long ago.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002580_BARNIER
264.description: Which is why we must in earnest begin preparations for the great exodus.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002590_BARNIER
265.description: For his impressive contributions and the leadership he demonstrated during our withdrawal from Dravania, we have elected Master Leveilleur to oversee this initiative.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002600_FOURCHENAULT
266.description: Fellow scribes and scholars. My countrymen. We face a threat of unprecedented scale.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002610_FOURCHENAULT
267.description: We must challenge the trials before us with composure and conviction if we are to find salvation.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002620_FOURCHENAULT
268.description: The wisdom of Sharlayan has ever been a shining beacon in the darkness, and so it shall continue to be.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002630_FOURCHENAULT
269.description: It is our solemn charge to see our heritage preserved for future generations. For those who will come after, we will brave a new frontier.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002640_BARNIER
270.description: Administrative edicts will be relayed to all major institutions ere long. In the meantime, carry on with your duties. With that, I hereby call this assembly to a close.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002650_ALISAIE
271.description: Do you remember what Mother told us when we visited home?

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002660_ALISAIE
272.description: That it wasn't until after we were born that Father seemed to lose himself in his work.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002670_ALISAIE
273.description: If that <hex:021A020203>great work<hex:021A020103> of his was the evacuation of this star, then...

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002680_ALPHINAUD
274.description: Yes... It wasn't for his benefit...

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002690_ALPHINAUD
275.description: Would you mind waiting here a moment? I wish to speak with Father before we leave.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002700_ALPHINAUD
279.description: Thank you. I shan't be long.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002710_ALPHINAUD
280.description: I may look daggers at him, but I will neither speak nor draw them.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002720_ALISAIE
281.description: If it's all the same to you, I have a few choice words to share with Father as well.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002730_FOURCHENAULT
282.description: So. Come to call us cowards and bid us join your fruitless battle against the inevitable?

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002740_ALPHINAUD
283.description: Nay, we do not object to the Forum's proposal. On the contrary, those who wish to flee have every right to do so.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002750_ALPHINAUD
284.description: Urianger is cooperating with your associates on the moon to ensure that all is ready should evacuation be our only recourse.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002760_FOURCHENAULT
285.description: Then whatever your business, I suggest you be brief.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002770_ALPHINAUD
286.description: Though we cannot boast the boundless wisdom of Sharlayan, we have firsthand knowledge of foreign cultures, and have conversed with no small number of peoples.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002780_ALPHINAUD
287.description: These experiences have taught us fundamental truths that cannot be recorded in any tome, nor charted on any map.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002790_ALPHINAUD
288.description: The beating heart of this planet is its people, many of whom would give anything─even their lives─to protect the lands they love.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002800_ALPHINAUD
289.description: Many may choose to join you in the end. But what of those unwilling or unable, for whom escape will never be an option? What would you have them do?

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002810_ALPHINAUD
290.description: To ignore the plight of those one might conceivably save is not wisdom, Father. It is indolence.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002820_ALPHINAUD
291.description: This is why we choose to fight.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002830_ALISAIE
292.description: We'll not ask for your understanding, Father. Only that you don't turn a blind eye to the good we have done. That we can still do.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002840_ALISAIE
293.description: We're not children in need of protection. Hold fast to your principles and let the world burn, if it please, but we believe there is still another way.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002850_ALISAIE
294.description: And if there is, we will find it. You see if we don't.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002860_FOURCHENAULT
295.description: Do as you will. Just stay out of our way.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002870_YSHTOLA
296.description: Were he not so consumed with self-righteousness, he might tell you how proud he is of you both.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002880_ESTINIEN
297.description: Bold words call for bold action. And there'll be no turning to your father should plans go awry.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002890_ALISAIE
298.description: As if I ever would. So long as there are those who wish to stay and fight for this star, we have to do what we can to help them.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002900_THANCRED
299.description: And if we're to do that, we'll need to be well rested.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002910_THANCRED
300.description: Wouldn't you agree? Having triumphed over what we once thought to be the source of all evil, I can think of no one in greater need of at least a dozen winks.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002920_ALPHINAUD
301.description: Shall we, then? To the annex, to prepare for tomorrow!

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002940_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
303.description: A visitor has come knocking at your door. Whoever could it be?

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002950_ALPHINAUD
311.description: Ah. I hope I didn't wake you.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002960_ALPHINAUD
312.description: I pray you will forgive the unannounced visit, but I wished to speak with you before retiring for the night...

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002970_ALPHINAUD
313.description: ...About Garlemald, and the time we spent with the people of Tertium.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002980_ALPHINAUD
314.description: Dangerous though it was, I'm glad we had the opportunity to treat with Jullus and Quintus.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_002990_ALPHINAUD
315.description: I was worried what might happen after we were collared. If they attempted to restrain you too. If they succeeded...

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003000_ALPHINAUD
316.description: Once more I put you in harm's way. And for that I must apologize...

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003010_ALPHINAUD
317.description: Or rather...I should thank you. For trusting in me, time and time again.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003020_ALPHINAUD
318.description: After all our journeys together, I daresay I've used every expression imaginable to convey to you my gratitude. Nevertheless, I hope these words of mine still carry some small weight.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003030_ALPHINAUD
319.description: Tomorrow our fight continues. Mayhap it would have been better to seek you out after we have true cause for celebration...

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003040_ALPHINAUD
320.description: But having mustered the courage to stand up to Father and achieve a personal victory of sorts, I wanted to carry on in that spirit before my nerves got the better of me.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003050_ALPHINAUD
321.description: The hour grows late, and you doubtless tire of my ramblings.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003060_ALPHINAUD
322.description: I have a letter for Arenvald to finish, but will be off to bed shortly. Sleep well.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003070_ALISAIE
323.description: Craving a midnight snack, were you? I did consider bringing a few sweets, but decided this wasn't an appropriate occasion.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003080_ALISAIE
324.description: I couldn't sleep. Had a few things on my mind. I know it's late, so I'll try not to talk your ear off...

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003090_ALISAIE
325.description: It's Zenos. I keep thinking back to Garlemald, when he'd taken control of your body.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003100_ALISAIE
326.description: An altogether terrifying experience, to say the least. And one that served as a harsh reminder.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003110_ALISAIE
327.description: No one─no matter how strong or quick or clever─is invincible. Not even you.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003120_ALISAIE
328.description: And as much as it might seem at times that you are...one misstep. One mistake...and that's that.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003130_ALISAIE
329.description: Which is why, even though I know you've heard it a thousand times before, I'm going to tell you to take better care of yourself. Because you really, really should.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003140_ALISAIE
330.description: It goes without saying that we're all committed to this fight, but that doesn't mean that we need to throw our lives away. You know how I feel about noble sacrifices.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003150_ALISAIE
331.description: Right─that's settled! We'll be keeping the acts of gratuitous bravado to a minimum.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003160_ALISAIE
332.description: When I looked Father in the eye and swore we'd find a way to avert this tragedy...

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003170_ALISAIE
333.description: It wasn't a promise just for him. It was a promise for you, too.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003180_THANCRED
334.description: Evening. I hoped you hadn't crawled beneath the covers just yet.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003190_THANCRED
335.description: If you'll indulge me for a moment, I have a favor to ask.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003200_THANCRED
336.description: Don't worry. Nothing desperate or dire, if that's what you were wondering. Not yet.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003210_THANCRED
337.description: You know, we may have quite literally entered our final days. The ancients went so far as to call it that for a reason.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003220_THANCRED
338.description: If so, then everything we did for Ryne, for the First...will have been meaningless. And I can't accept that. I just can't.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003230_THANCRED
339.description: My mind won't allow for the possibility...and that could be a problem. When we're in the thick of it, I don't know if I've got it in me to be pragmatic this time. To run...even if running's the right choice. The only choice.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003240_THANCRED
340.description: So if you see me turning a blind eye to the harsh reality...beat some sense into me, would you?

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003250_THANCRED
341.description: I trust you and the other Scions with my life, and I'd like to think the feeling is at least occasionally mutual.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003260_THANCRED
342.description: And I'd never forgive myself if my stubbornness put them in danger.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003270_THANCRED
343.description: Gods, listen to me. I'm beginning to sound like the father I never had.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003280_THANCRED
344.description: So, can I count on you to keep me in line? I can think of no one else more eminently qualified.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003300_THANCRED
346.description: Now I can breathe a bit easier. Which isn't to say that I will, given what we're up against.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003310_THANCRED
347.description: Let's keep this little chat our secret. I'd rather not have anyone scolding us for burning the midnight oil.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003330_YSHTOLA
349.description: Might I trouble you to stand still for a moment?

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003340_YSHTOLA
350.description: Hmmm. Nothing appears out of the ordinary.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003350_YSHTOLA
351.description: A precautionary measure. You will recall that serving as a vessel for abundant Light in the First very nearly ended poorly.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003360_YSHTOLA
352.description: In your recent battle on the moon, you were almost certainly exposed to similar, if not greater forces. Fortunately, from what I can see, you and your aether are none the worse for wear.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003370_YSHTOLA
353.description: Would that Ryne were here to confirm my assessment...

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003380_YSHTOLA
354.description: To think you actually found yourself in a direct confrontation with Zodiark...

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003390_YSHTOLA
355.description: As if Zenos gallivanting about in your body was not misfortune enough. Did you so grossly offend every single deity in a past life that they saw fit to place a curse upon your soul?

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003400_YSHTOLA
356.description: Forgive me, that was in poor taste. I recall vividly how battered and broken it was in the depths of Amaurot.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003410_YSHTOLA
357.description: Would that you could have seen it with your own eyes. Mayhap then you would understand why the greater part of me is glad you did not. It was...a horror beyond description.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003420_YSHTOLA
358.description: Promise me you will be careful. That you will seek my counsel if you feel unwell.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003430_YSHTOLA
359.description: That puts my heart at ease, if only a touch. I suspect it will grow colder as the night wears on, so do be sure to stay warm.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003440_YSHTOLA
360.description: Sleep well, and may the shadows keep you.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003450_GRAHATIA
361.description: Oh, apologies. I-I didn't mean to... Ahem. If you could spare a moment before bed...

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003460_GRAHATIA
362.description: Thank you. I fear this may be the last quiet night we have to talk for quite some time.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003470_GRAHATIA
363.description: I am...troubled, of late. Unwarranted concerns, perhaps. I hope. Nevertheless, I feel compelled to share them with you.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003480_GRAHATIA
364.description: Though you have bested your enemies thus far─Zenos, and even Zodiark─your victories have come at a considerable cost to yourself.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003490_GRAHATIA
365.description: No one is without their limits─and you are no exception. I worry the added weight of the Final Days will prove more than you can bear.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003500_GRAHATIA
366.description: It is surely too much for any one <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>...

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003510_GRAHATIA
367.description: But you needn't bear it alone. Let me share your burden.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003520_GRAHATIA
368.description: My, um...carrying capacity pales in comparison to yours, but I could still help. Shoulder the occasional satchel from your ever-growing mountain of, um...baggage.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003530_GRAHATIA
369.description: You have already done so much to help relieve me of mine own encumbrances. 'Tis only fair that I repay you in kind.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003540_GRAHATIA
370.description: Of course, it needn't be only troubles we share.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003550_GRAHATIA
371.description: Moments of joy may seem few and far between now, but there will come a time when we look back fondly on this journey.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003560_GRAHATIA
372.description: The inquiry at the Forum, our march through the snows of Garlemald, our impromptu dinner in this very room─all of it.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003570_GRAHATIA
373.description: And that is to say nothing of the journeys yet to come. To the ends of the world and beyond!

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003580_GRAHATIA
374.description: Ahem. But tomorrow will be no less busy than today, and I have kept you from your rest long enough.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003610_ESTINIEN
377.description: The twins thought now would be a wonderful time to pay a visit to my chambers. Rather than listen to them bicker over tonight's snacks and tomorrow's plans, I seized the first opportunity to make my escape.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003620_ESTINIEN
378.description: To their credit, they decided against intruding on your peace and quiet.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003630_ESTINIEN
379.description: It can all be a bit...exhausting at times, can't it?

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003640_ESTINIEN
380.description: I wasn't sure what to make of you at first. During the Dragonsong War, how quick you were to take up a cause not your own. But I came to see that is simply the way of you and yours.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003650_ESTINIEN
381.description: I will not pretend to understand this talk of ancient primals and the Final Days.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003660_ESTINIEN
382.description: But I trust in your judgment and choose to believe in your cause. You and Alphinaud have my lance. Now and always.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003670_ESTINIEN
383.description: You will need it, wrack and ruin looming on the horizon. Calamity bearing down upon us.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003680_ESTINIEN
384.description: There's no place I'd rather be than here. Standing shoulder to shoulder with friends on the front line.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003690_ESTINIEN
385.description: So do not hesitate to send me against your enemies. I'll make them rue the day they met me.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003700_ESTINIEN
386.description: Now, if you'll excuse me. I could do with a little air.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003710_ESTINIEN
387.description: If Alphinaud asks... I was never here.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003730_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
389.description: A short while earlier, in the Ala Mhigan Quarter...

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003740_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
390.description: Thank the gods that tower is gone. The sight of it was enough to make me sick...

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003750_ALAMHIGANCITIZENB
391.description: Thank the Ilsabard contingent, more like. Word is they fought their way into Garlemald and toppled the bloody thing themselves. Not just the one, neither─all the towers have up and vanished.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003760_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
392.description: Aye, I heard the same. Commander Aldynn and his troops helped keep casualties to a minimum, too.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003770_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
393.description: But is it true they brought back tempered Garlean soldiers?

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003780_ALAMHIGANCITIZENB
394.description: As Commander Aldynn tells it, they've a treatment for that now. But don't you worry─cured or not, they've no plans to bring them into the city proper.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003790_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
395.description: I see. Well, that's a relief, then.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003800_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
396.description: I know we've brothers and sisters among the lot, but I can't say I'm eager to welcome them home...

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003810_ALAMHIGANCITIZENB
397.description: Won't need to think about it for a while yet. They're to be looked after in Ala Gannha for the time being...

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003830_ERENVILLE
399.description: Another day, another commission of paramount importance...

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003870_ERENVILLE
403.description: Was that...? No. The shadows play tricks. Nothing more.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003880_ERENVILLE
404.description: The towers are gone, and the Garlean threat has abated. And yet...

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06002_003890_ERENVILLE
405.description: Why does it feel as though it's about to get much, much worse...?
